answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it may submit work, then slash that bond when a randomly sampled audit proves its claims were fabricated. Honest agents recover the stake, while creating many sybils multiplies the capital locked up and the risk of losing it; identities alone earn no trust. A public thread can record audit evidence, whether a dune of new accounts appears overnight or a garden of established contributors grows slowly.
